items.item_text: Bachelors Other, chemical, physical, or biological science from an accredited institution upon hire required and
One (1) to (3) three years experience; 2 years working in a laboratory setting preferred and co-op or internship experience in a laboratory setting or prior acute care experience preferred
Weekend and varied shift rotations (including emergency) is expected
Establishes and maintains cooperative relationships with patients, staff using a humanistic attitude (anticipates needs, is respectful, caring and courteous).
Employee has met and acknowledged all initial / annual competencies as required for position
Evaluates test results by accessing, calculating and verifying using instrument protocol from observed data and reports via LIS and / or phone
Performs quality control tests evaluates data for accuracy and precision and troubleshoots problems if / when they occur

Supports the quality control program appropriate for the testing performed and recognizes the parameters for acceptable levels of analytic performance and ensures that these levels are maintained throughout the entire testing process from the initial receipt of the specimen, through sample analysis and reporting of test results.
Clinical Lab Scientist: CA (CLS: CA) upon hire or
Requires one (1) year of training post baccalaureate
Ability to demonstrate a familiarity and understanding of medical terminology, typing, math and computer skills
